name: E-Teller Bank Mini API

errors.403: {message} wrong actor/role, blocked staff, closed customer, or admin account protection

endpoints.purpose: Single login gateway for all roles. Staff send username+password, customers send identifier+pin.

identifier.rules: required, max 50; NIS or account number

endpoints.response: 200 {data:{actor:'staff'|'customer', token, token_type:'Bearer', user: Staff | customer: Customer}}
errors: 422 wrong credentials / blocked staff / closed account / missing fields
422 PIN locked: 'Terlalu banyak percobaan PIN salah. Coba lagi pukul HH:MM.' (shared lock; remaining attempts are not revealed before the lock)
429 more than 5 attempts per minute per identifier+IP
endpoints.notes: If username is filled the staff login runs; else if identifier is filled the customer login runs; else 422 on username. Customer PINs are checked through the shared PIN lock (3 wrong in a row lock login, withdrawal approval and PIN change for 15 minutes).
